subjects.pell: PELL the fisher: lean middle aged dark-skinned woman, short silver curls, navy knitted beanie, ochre fishing vest, cream sleeves, muted blue trousers, brown boots, wicker creel on hip. No rod.
subjects.corin: CORIN the market seller: broad cheerful adult man with dark skin, bald head, round ochre ear studs, rust-red short waistcoat, cream rolled sleeves, olive green apron, brown trousers, brown shoes. No hat, no moustache.
subjects.hesper: HESPER the washer: sturdy older woman with warm brown skin, cream cloth wrapped high over hair, muted blue rolled-sleeve blouse, rust skirt, cream sash and brown ankle boots. No apron, no headscarf like villager-a.
subjects.dunn: DUNN the town guard: tall stout adult woman with fair skin, short straight black bob, round dull steel kettle helmet, ochre padded tunic, muted slate-blue shoulder cape, rust trousers, dark boots. Empty hands, no weapon.
subjects.isolde: ISOLDE the scholar: slight elderly dark-skinned man, bald crown and white side hair, tiny round brass spectacles, long muted violet robe, cream scarf hanging in two straight ends, brown shoes. No hat, no beard.
subjects.nessa: NESSA the grandmother: round elderly fair-skinned woman, large silver hair bun, rust-red shawl around shoulders, dark olive dress, cream collar, brown boots, walking cane held close to body. No hat.
subjects.roan: ROAN the farmhand: lanky teenage boy with warm tan skin, very short blond hair, no hat, cream tunic with rolled sleeves, rust-red neckerchief, moss-green dungarees, brown boots. No tools, no straw hat.
subjects.pip: PIP the apprentice: young child age nine, dark skin and two short black hair puffs, ochre cap worn backward, muted violet short tunic, cream shorts, rust socks and brown shoes, small brown cross-body satchel. Shorter body and visibly childlike face, same large head scale as reference.
